primary_target: mean agency-reported SIZE_HA among eligible size-observed NFDB Ontario incidents in each year
inner_validation: three expanding chronological splits inside each outer training window
fire_policy: SRC_AGENCY ON; valid YEAR; quarantine all duplicated or blank NFDBFIREID and nonblank PRESCRIBED or FIRE_TYPE PB; retain incidents without precise dates/coordinates; unknown/negative size excluded only from size denominator, never treated as zero
weather_policy: equal eligible station weight; annual mean temperature requires at least nine measured months; annual totals and extremes require twelve; summer JJA and spring MAM require all three; preserve station counts and missing months; no incident weighting
primary_information_policy: same-year climate, retrospective annual estimation; not advance forecast
target_transform: log1p annual mean hectares, standardize using each training fold only; report inverse-transformed MAE/RMSE/bias in hectares
preprocessing: training median imputation and StandardScaler within every inner/outer fold
rbf_gamma: training median squared pair distance heuristic, fixed per fold

quantum.matrix_cache: one matrix per fold/map; reuse across C/epsilon

baseline_gate: measure annual classical outcomes before optional selectors, shot diagnostics or search policy changes
optional_followups: four-feature selection with training-only classical relevance and bounded QUBO controls
area-weighted woodland only with a valid Ontario mask
selection_budget: no more than four separately frozen follow-up plans; no test-guided revision; core classical/quantum regressors mandatory
test_rule: freeze selected configurations and code before one annual reused-test evaluation; do not alter incident intent or evidence
limits: reported size does not certify final burned area
woodland bounding crop is not an Ontario polygon
